observations: Photo 0 shows a beige and cream-colored sewing machine with a red and white patterned fabric under the needle.
The machine has a large dial on the front, a handwheel on the left, and a power cord extending from the back.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with the needle and presser foot visible, and a black foot pedal connected to the machine.
The machine appears to be a vintage or retro-style model, possibly a domestic or industrial sewing machine.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON Jiji SHARON TAYLOR' on both photos.
No brand or model name is visible on the machine in either photo.
